titulo: In Gaza City, a funeral for 112 family members takes place 3 years after their deaths
cuerpo: Nearly three years after more than 100 of their relatives were killed in an Israeli airstrike in Gaza City, surviving members of the Abu Sharia and Hasayna families say they're relieved to be able to finally lay them to rest, but can't help but think of all the remains still waiting under the rubble.
